title: A Valid Winning Trade
hook: It won. That’s not why it was good.

launchpad.outcome: Work a valid trade from the 4H down, decide before the outcome, and explain why it was good without using the result.
launchpad.missionQuestion: Why did this trade deserve to be taken?

slides.headline: It won. That’s not why it was good.
slides.line: A finished long with Dayli’s marks. The result is hidden. Decide if it was a good trade before you know how it ended.

slides.headline: Tick what made it a good trade.
slides.do: Only what you could know before the result. Two of these are traps.

options.label: The 4H and 1H agreed
options.sub: The thesis was there before the open.

options.label: The full I → C → C closed
options.sub: Every step was a close, not a wick.

options.label: It hit the target
options.why: Trap: that’s the result. You only knew it after.

options.label: The candles were big and fast
options.why: Trap: candle size isn’t a rule.

slides.trapSay: You ticked a result as a reason. “It won” can’t make a trade valid.
slides.goodSay: All five reasons, and no traps. Everything you ticked was known before the entry.

slides.headline: Watch it play out.
slides.dayli: It deserved to be taken before it won. That’s what makes it a good trade.

takeaways: A good trade is judged on thesis, validity, execution, risk and management.
“Because it won” is never the reason.
remember: A winner is useful when you can explain why it deserved to be taken before it won.
